sections.whatsHappening: You must serve and file documents before certain events in your case. At least 14 days before the settlement conference, each party must serve on every other party and file with the court a copy of any document to be relied on at the trial, including an expert report, not attached to the party's claim or defence. You must also serve and file a list of proposed witnesses, on Form 13A. At least 30 days before the trial date, a document served on all parties who were served with the notice of trial shall be received in evidence, unless the trial judge orders otherwise.
sections.whatToDoNext: Ensure you serve and file the required documents within the specified timeframes. Use the appropriate methods of service as outlined in the Rules of the Small Claims Court. Keep detailed notes of the service process for your affidavit of service.
sections.whatHappensAfter: Once you have served and filed the documents, they will be considered by the court. If you serve a document at least 30 days before the trial, it will be received in evidence unless the trial judge decides otherwise. If you wish to cross-examine a witness or author of a document served by another party, you may summon them as a witness.
